ResearchProjectDef.label: knife
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft small metal blades with handles, useful for quick cuts and close-range stabbing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mace
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft refined impact weapons with weighted heads for efficient, armor-crushing swings.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gladius
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft short ancient-style swords balanced for fast stabbing and close slashing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bolt-action rifle
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft long-barreled manually-cycled rifles for accurate hunting and careful long-range fire.

ResearchProjectDef.label: smoke launcher
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft wide-barreled launchers that lob smoke shells to screen movement and break turret locks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: incendiary launcher
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft wide-barreled launchers that hurl volatile fire bolts into clustered targets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: molotov cocktails
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft improvised incendiary weapons from glass bottles, flammable fuel, and cloth wicks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: frag grenades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft hand-thrown explosive charges in fragmenting casings for attacking clustered targets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: charge lance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft rail-assisted weapons that propel a single pulse-charged projectile at extreme velocity.
